main_text.p: tos natibus, Jes.20.4. pro חשופים & est loco Constructi, vide simile in יד. Infin. ולחשף מים Ad hauriendum aquam, Jesa.30.14.

חשיפים m. p. Greges: Constructum, חשיפי עזים Parvi greges caprarum, 1.Reg.20.27. id est, rari, quasi Nudi dicti, quòd præ paucitate & raritate ipsorum, terra quasi Nuda appareret, cùm hostis suâ multitudine terram op-pleret.

חשק Amavit, Amore propendit vel propensus fuit, Desideravit: Construitur cum Accusativo & Præpositione ב: Præter. באבתיך חשק In majores tuos propensius fuit, Deut.10.15. חשק לבנו Desiderravit aedificare, 1.Reg.9.19. חשקה נפשו בנתכם Amore propendet animus ejus erga filiam vestram, Genes.34.v.8. Pih. חשק Cingere: Præterit. וחשק אתם Et cinxit vel fasciis redimivit eas, Exod.38.28. Pyh.Patt. מחשקים כסף Cincta erant argento, id est, fasciis argenteis, Exod.27.17.
חשק m. Desiderium, 1.Reg.9.19. Aff. את נפשי חשקי Crepusculum desiderii mei, Jesa.21.4. id est, desideratissimum, suavissimum.
חשוקים m. p. Fasciæ, Cinctûræ, Orbes: Aff. וחשקיהם Et fascias illarum, Exod.27.10.
חשקים m. p. Canthi, exterior rotæ cinctura: Aff. וחשקיהם Et canthi earum, 1.Reg.7.33.
חשר חשרים m. p. Radii rotarum: Aff. וחשריהם Et radii ipsarum, 1.Reg.7.33. Kimchi in lib.Rad. putat convenire cum קשר Ligare, & Radii dicuntur quasi Ligamenta rotarum.
חשרת f. Colligatio: Constr. חשרת־מים Colligationem aquarum, 2.Sam.22.12. id est, nubium densarum, quas aquas effundunt, ut Kimchi explicat in Comminent. Pro eo

page.notes: The Hebrew forms are copied as far as legible; some vowel points and the word after "Præpositione" are uncertain. The word "Comminent." is doubtful: the printed form may be "Comment." Large initial letters (חשק, חשר) are dictionary entries, not headings. "op-pleret" keeps the printed hyphen at the line end. The catchword "legitur" is at the lower right.
